description: DATEPARM is a DATASET, not a PARM, and an empty one produces an empty report. app/jcl/TRANREPT.jcl:73-74 binds DD DATEPARM to a dataset and the job declares no PARM at all, so 0550-DATEPARM-READ at :220-243 is the only source of the reporting range. Seeded empty, that READ reports '10', the EVALUATE takes its second arm and moves 16 to APPL-RESULT, and the APPL-EOF test at :235 moves 'Y' to END-OF-FILE before the loop has run once. So TRANFILE is never read even though it holds a perfectly good in-range record, no 'Reporting from' line is displayed because that line is on the APPL-AOK arm, and the program ends normally with RETURN-CODE 0.
